dedupe_keys.name: a global analysis of subsidence relative sea level change and coastal flood exposure

description: Robert J. Nicholls and colleagues publish inputs and R processing code for global subsidence and relative sea-level exposure analysis. The January 2021 Zenodo archive is freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0. Its linked repository documents DIVA coastal segments, regional values, city subsidence assumptions, 117 deltas, glacial-isostatic adjustments and satellite sea-level fields, assembled into 2015 relative sea-level estimates. These inputs can support coastal flood-exposure simulations with alternative subsidence assumptions. Catalogue record model-diva-coastal-impact-adaptation describes the wider modelling family but does not explicitly cover this study package. City-rate persistence, global spatial aggregation and local coastal representation remain limitations; uncertainty was not independently quantified. The Zenodo creator metadata misplace given names in affiliation fields, so those fields were not copied as institutions. Only metadata and README documentation were inspected.
